messages:
Nina: Heads up: noticed a pattern where client-side truncation + immediate retry leads to ledger showing extra tokens. UI still matches expected. Repro on canary.
Omar: any traces?
Nina: trace=retry-trc-21, router=canary-3. Excerpt: 
Nina: ```
[2026-04-01T08:41:12Z] session=retry-trc-21 client-truncate offset=64
[2026-04-01T08:41:12Z] session=retry-trc-21 client-retry start (no idempotency key)
[2026-04-01T08:41:13Z] session=retry-trc-21 chunk-ack offset=64 ledger-tag=lt-999
[2026-04-01T08:41:13Z] session=retry-trc-21 chunk-ack offset=64 ledger-tag=lt-1000
```
Liu: double ledger-tag suggests two toolcall attributions. Router may be allocating tag on toolcall-confirm but retry path triggers allocation twice.
Omar: quick query to spot similar duplicates: 
Omar: ```sql
SELECT session_id, ledger_tag, count(*) FROM stream_acks WHERE timestamp > '2026-03-31' GROUP BY session_id, ledger_tag HAVING count(*)>1;
```
Nina: infra-bot fired alert "metering-dup-ack-rate 3x baseline" and created INC-7701.
infra-bot: incident INC-7701 created, assigned to @oncall.
Liu: mitigation options: 1) ensure idempotency enforced at client/proxy for retry; 2) move ledger_tag allocation earlier (on initial truncate) and propagate; 3) reconcile duplicates in ledger job (post-facto).
Omar: prefer (2) + (1). small router patch idea: if X-Client-Truncate present and no X-Ledger-Tag, pre-assign one and pass down. Pseudocode: 
Omar: ```go
if req.Header.Get("X-Client-Truncate")!="" && req.Header.Get("X-Ledger-Tag")=="" {
 req.Header.Set("X-Ledger-Tag", allocLedgerTag())
}
```
Liu: also add a probe: count of sessions where same offset has >1 distinct ledger_tag within 1s window. Add console panel and alert at 0.5%.
Nina: I'll open the PR for the router change and add the console ask. Pausing canary until patch lands.
Omar: add unit+integration test for proxy strip case (proxy sometimes rewrites headers).
infra-bot: noted. Postmortem label attached.
Nina: timeline: PR by EOD -> canary apply -> monitor 45m -> unpause. Anyone object?
Liu: no objections. I'll run reconciliation sweep after deploy and report results here.
Nina: thanks, keeping this thread for follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
